turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on always, usually, sometimes and never?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Let's practise. Words like always, usually, sometimes and never go before the main verb: I never have coffee in the evening. With he, she or it, the verb still needs -s: My brother usually gets up at seven.

Put the words in order to make a sentence:
"always / I / breakfast / have / at seven"
